summary: Official Uttar Pradesh BhuLekh/Bhu-Naksha land-record services were found and their current public BhuLekh JavaScript configuration was inspected. The public API bases were exercised anonymously, but bounded requests returned HTTP 500 and no parcel vector response. No geometry sample is retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Hindi discovery queries, exact text, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-10267-naugarh.json.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET retrieved https://upbhulekh.gov.in/, https://upbhulekh.gov.in/bhulekh/, the official digitization dashboard, and the NIC Bhu-Naksha landing page. The current BhuLekh bundle exposed apiUrl=https://upbhulekh.gov.in/PublicBhuApi/api and apiForMap=https://upbhulekh.gov.in/PublicBhuApi/bhunaksha. Anonymous GET requests to both bases and the guessed /api/districts route returned HTTP 500 with no usable JSON. The generic NIC Bhu-Naksha page returned HTTP 200 but states it is intended for authorized officials; no login was attempted. No city-specific map extent, schema/CRS response, native ID, or parcel geometry was obtained.
